_how: Your own opening hours for Bar Roulette. One line per place: "id or exact name": "hours". Put a comma after every line except the last.
_ids: Use the id from missing-hours.csv (for example node/123456 or brreg/912345678). An exact name also works, but only if no other place has that name.
_format: Hours look like: Mo-Fr 07:00-23:00; Sa 08:00-22:00; Su off   or   24/7   or   closed (the place has shut down for good).
